variants.notes: VERIFICATION: material part bit-exact; engine tail replaced by UE translucency lighting (approximation). The port (WuwaToonBodyV2PropTransNoPBRSecondBump2SBasePass, WuwaToonBasePass_V2Props.ush) returns the material values (Emissive, Opacity, toon lit colour, and the Kuro toon-lighting inputs shadow colour / shadow / AO / normal); bit-exact through the whole original o0 with those registers overwritten (identity control and negative controls above). Not ported (engine tail): primitive fade, vertex / volumetric height fog, emissive scale and OOB stripes, Kuro forward toon lighting (screen shadow mask / CSM, local-light list, translucency volume), pre-exposure. In UE the spec is "resolve": false with the lit-translucent template (DefaultLit, BLEND_Translucent, TwoSided): Emissive -> Emissive Color, Opacity -> Opacity, OutBaseColor -> Base Color, lit by UE translucency lighting; the Kuro primitive fade is not applied.
